title: Introducing musicOS Flow 🌊
message:
Get ready for a revolutionary way to discover music in musicOS!

✨ Flow Highlights:
• 🔥 Best Part First: Skips slow intros and jumps straight to the chorus & viral hooks powered by YouTube heatmaps.
• ⏱️ 30s Auto-Preview: Tracks refresh seamlessly every 30 seconds with a glowing real-time countdown progress bar.
• 💎 Hard Glass Aesthetic: Tactile frosted glass action rail, specular rim light borders, and spinning vinyl disc.
• 🔀 Infinite Horizon: 14+ genres and dynamic radio algorithms with non-repeating recommendations.
• ⚡ Seamless Queue Promotion: Tap Play anytime to enjoy the full track uninterrupted.

"Flow is built so the best moments of music come straight to you without waiting."
— Nexa ❤️
